mapper.select: SELECT id, name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time FROM patient ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.gender, p.admission_number, p.phone, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM patient p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pd.patient_id, MIN(pd.doctor_id) AS doctor_id FROM patient_doctor pd INNER JOIN (SELECT patient_id, MIN(create_time) AS min_ct FROM patient_doctor GROUP BY patient_id) t ON pd.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pd.create_time = t.min_ct GROUP BY pd.patient_id ) cr ON p.id = cr.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor creator ON cr.doctor_id = creator.id WHERE creator.id IS NULL OR creator.level != 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT id, name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time FROM patient WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR admission_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.gender, p.admission_number, p.phone, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM patient p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pd.patient_id, MIN(pd.doctor_id) AS doctor_id FROM patient_doctor pd INNER JOIN (SELECT patient_id, MIN(create_time) AS min_ct FROM patient_doctor GROUP BY patient_id) t ON pd.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pd.create_time = t.min_ct GROUP BY pd.patient_id ) cr ON p.id = cr.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor creator ON cr.doctor_id = creator.id WHERE (creator.id IS NULL OR creator.level != 0) AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.admission_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.gender, p.admission_number, p.phone, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM patient p INNER JOIN patient_doctor pd ON p.id = pd.patient_id WHERE pd.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.gender, p.admission_number, p.phone, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM patient p INNER JOIN patient_doctor pd ON p.id = pd.patient_id WHERE pd.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.admission_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient (name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{admissionNumber}, #{phone}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE patient SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, admission_number = #{admissionNumber}, phone = #{phone}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
